description: SaaS Pricing & Competitor Battlecard Spy — Reads up to 3 competitor sites (homepage and pricing page, fetched in parallel) and returns a deal battlecard in under a minute: a verdict headline with confidence, pricing tiers whose amounts are checked against the page text, a scenario cost comparison computed in code, hidden fees and limits, landmine questions, objection handling, wedge features and a talk track. If a site or model step fails

competitorUrls.description: Competitor homepage or pricing URLs. A same-site pricing page is discovered automatically.

scenario.description: Optional deal size used to compute monthly and annual cost per verified tier: seats for per-seat prices, monthlyVolume for usage prices.

name: competitor-battlecard
